standard.summary: training_type 决定训练的整体模式：'lora' 只训练 LoRA 适配器（冻结底模）；'finetune' 训练底模所有参数（全参微调）。
standard.effect: LoRA 模式参数少、训练快、文件小；Finetune 模式参数多、质量天花板高但需要更多显存和时间。
standard.whenToUse: lora 是绝大多数场景的推荐选择。finetune 仅在追求最高质量且有足够计算资源时使用。
standard.avoidWhen: 不要在没有足够显存的情况下选择 finetune（FLUX/Anima 全参微调可能需要 80GB+）。

standard_en.summary: training_type decides the overall mode of training: 'lora' trains only the LoRA adapter (the base model is frozen); 'finetune' trains all the base model's parameters (a full finetune).
standard_en.effect: LoRA mode has few parameters, trains fast and produces a small file; finetune mode has many parameters and a higher quality ceiling, but needs more VRAM and more time.
standard_en.whenToUse: lora is the recommended choice for the great majority of cases. Use finetune only when you are after the highest quality and have the compute for it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not choose finetune without enough VRAM (a full FLUX/Anima finetune may need 80GB+).

advanced.principle: LoRA 模式只创建可训练的 adapter 层（network_dim × in/out），底模权重被冻结不参与梯度计算。Finetune 模式所有参数都参与训练，使用标准的 SGD/AdamW 更新。Anima finetune 支持渐进式解冻（anima_progressive_full_finetune_schedule）。
advanced.intervention: trainer 根据 training_type 决定构建 LoRA adapter 还是加载全参。
advanced.expectedImpact: LoRA 文件通常 10-200MB。Finetune 输出完整模型权重（数 GB）。
advanced.tradeoffs: anima_full_finetune_phase 控制 Anima 全参微调的阶段策略。
advanced.codePath: trainer.py:training_type dispatch → LoRA adapter creation / full parameter training

advanced_en.principle: LoRA mode only creates trainable adapter layers (network_dim × in/out); the base model weights are frozen and take no part in gradient computation. Finetune mode trains all parameters with standard SGD/AdamW updates. Anima finetune supports progressive unfreezing (anima_progressive_full_finetune_schedule).
advanced_en.intervention: The trainer builds a LoRA adapter or loads full parameters depending on training_type.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: LoRA files are usually 10-200MB. Finetune outputs full model weights (several GB).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: anima_full_finetune_phase controls the phase strategy of Anima full-parameter finetuning.
advanced_en.codePath: trainer.py:training_type dispatch → LoRA adapter creation / full parameter training
